resources.string: gim works a bit differently from other chat apps. Here is what to know.
You don\'t need a phone number or email. Just pick a name. gim gives you an Account ID.
Your account lives on your devices
Your account is kept on your phone, not on a server. Want to use it somewhere else? Link another device.
Messages are end-to-end encrypted. Only the people in the chat can read them. Not even the server can.
Your Account ID is your address
Share your Account ID so friends can reach you. You can also pick a username to make you easier to find.
Your recovery key is a spare key
Lost all your devices? Your recovery key and Account ID bring your account back. Old chats don\'t come back. Keep the key secret and safe. Never show it to anyone.
